diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
index 5ec8a4c..8895da7 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/test_shared.py
@@ -17,9 +17,12 @@
 # You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 # along with qutebrowser.  If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 
+from unittest import mock
+
 import pytest
 
 from qutebrowser.browser import shared
+from qutebrowser.utils import usertypes
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('dnt, accept_language, custom_headers, expected', [
@@ -45,3 +48,48 @@ def test_custom_headers(config_stub, dnt, accept_language, custom_headers,
 
     expected_items = sorted(expected.items())
     assert shared.custom_headers(url=None) == expected_items
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, level, msg, expected', [
+    ('userscript:style', usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'CSP blocked style', False),
+    ('userscript:style', usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'Unexpected failure', True),
+    ('qute:internal', usertypes.JsLogLevel.error, 'CSP blocked style', True),
+    ('userscript:style', usertypes.JsLogLevel.info, 'Unexpected failure', False),
+])
+def test_js_log_to_ui(config_stub, monkeypatch, source, level, msg, expected):
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error'], 'qute:*': ['error']}
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:*': ['*CSP blocked*']}
+    shown = mock.Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setitem(shared._JS_LOGMAP_MESSAGE, level, shown)
+
+    assert shared._js_log_to_ui(level, source, 66, msg) is expected
+    if expected:
+        shown.assert_called_once_with(f'JS: [{source}:66] {msg}')
+    else:
+        shown.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_javascript_log_message_excluded_uses_logger(config_stub, monkeypatch):
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.levels = {
+        'userscript:*': ['error']}
+    config_stub.val.content.javascript.log_message.excludes = {
+        'userscript:*': ['*CSP*']}
+    shown = mock.Mock()
+    logged = mock.Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setitem(shared._JS_LOGMAP_MESSAGE, usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                        shown)
+    monkeypatch.setitem(shared._JS_LOGMAP, 'debug', logged)
+
+    shared.javascript_log_message(usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                                  'userscript:style', 66, 'CSP blocked style')
+    logged.assert_called_once_with('[userscript:style:66] CSP blocked style')
+    shown.assert_not_called()
+
+    logged.reset_mock()
+    shared.javascript_log_message(usertypes.JsLogLevel.error,
+                                  'userscript:style', 67, 'Unexpected failure')
+    shown.assert_called_once_with(
+        'JS: [userscript:style:67] Unexpected failure')
+    logged.assert_not_called()
